disposition.description: Choose needs_evidence when a consequential method/default/identity is unresolved. draft_ready requires a complete self-contained public brief with no guessed science.
disposition.title: Disposition

review.description: Actual Markdown coverage/fidelity review with evidence citations and concrete blockers. A generic endorsement or promise of a review is not a review.
review.title: Review

task_brief.description: Complete standalone solver instructions when draft_ready; empty string otherwise. Never a placeholder, summary or cross-reference to the private plan. The solver will receive only this field and the public input files.
task_brief.title: Task Brief

validation_plan.description: Return the actual factory-facing validation plan or precise evidence requests in full. Private means excluded from solver-visible files, not withheld from this response. Include checks/controls still needed; do not invent numeric tolerances.
validation_plan.title: Validation Plan
